import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
one=np.ones_like(t)
def run(name,S,p0):
    def model(p):
        s=S(p)
        Pf=[one,P,P**2,P**3]
        X=np.column_stack([q for q in Pf]+[s*q for q in Pf]+[t*q for q in Pf])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
        return X@c
    best=None
    for s0 in p0:
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: model(p)-dP_dt, s0)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as ex: pass
    print(name, best.x, np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
run('sigmoid',lambda p: 1/(1+p[1]*np.exp(-p[0]*t)),[[0.5,1],[1,3],[0.3,0.5]])
run('gompertz',lambda p: np.exp(-p[1]*np.exp(-p[0]*t)),[[0.5,1],[1,3],[0.3,0.5]])
run('power sat',lambda p: 1-(1+p[0]*t)**(-p[1]),[[0.5,1],[1,2],[0.2,0.5]])
run('exp mult t',lambda p: (1-np.exp(-p[0]*t))**p[1],[[0.6,1],[0.5,2],[1,0.5]])
